query: LTX2MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch on sm120 dereferences sageattention._qattn_sm89 module attributes that sageattention 2.x no longer exposes (kernels moved to torch.ops.sageattention_qattn_sm89.*), causing AttributeError at first sampling step.

desired.outcome: Commenter feigo313 (2026-08-29) confirmed a temporary workaround: dispatch generic sageattn(q,k,v,tensor_layout='NHD') for sm120/sm121 or resolve kernels via torch.ops.sageattention_qattn_sm89.*; not maintainer-applied.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
